rules.rationale: This unconditional equation defines the total mathematical summary inClosedSpan by expanding it to the inclusive endpoint-order-independent Boolean predicate; it does not execute or observe a program configuration.
This constructor case defines keepDigit for a true selector by prepending the named digit to the remaining mathematical value sequence; it is one branch of an exhaustive structural helper.

This constructor case defines keepDigit for a false selector by returning the remaining mathematical value sequence unchanged; together with the true case it completes the structural helper definition.

This unconditional finite equation defines expectedDigits as the ordered composition of the inClosedSpan and keepDigit summaries for 2, 4, 6, and 8; it names the postcondition value without replacing program execution.
